headline: Vedanta Chairman Slams Government Transfer of Cambay Oil Block
summary: Vedanta Chairman Anil Agarwal warned that the Indian government's decision to hand over the producing Cambay offshore block to ONGC after denying a contract extension sends a bad signal to investors.
why: Vedanta is a diversified natural resources conglomerate. Upstream concession renewals and dispute outcomes affect private investment sentiment in India's energy sector.

impacts.name: Vedanta
impacts.why: Loss of the offshore Cambay production block reduces Vedanta's oil and gas operating reserves.
